p_ql1: Fine-tuned QLoRA-fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B (4-bit, Unsloth, TRL) using 0.52% of parameters, raising answer completion from 32% to 52% and exact-answer accuracy from 16.2% to 27.3% on held-out NuminaMath problems (n=99).
p_ql3: Reported that accuracy on completed answers barely moved (50% vs 52%), attributing the gain to staying within the token budget rather than stronger reasoning. Identified out-of-memory errors due to multiple models loaded in one runtime, not the KV cache.
